source_description: Original generated imagery; art direction specified by parent, no proprietary Globant media or screenshots used.

assets.name: software-product
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original editorial thumbnail for a premium Spanish digital-engineering company website service card.
Primary request: authentic contemporary software designers and engineers seen in profile, candidly collaborating at a large monitor.
Scene: a real contemporary software studio in evening practical light, restrained and credible. One woman and one man are focused on their work rather than posing; profile and three-quarter profile view.
Style: nuanced high-end editorial photography with realistic skin and fabric, subtly grainy dark atmospheric depth.
Composition: ultra-wide landscape 3:1 banner, full-bleed photograph, no border, subjects and monitor contained within a narrow horizontal crop. Output exactly 1536 by 512 pixels if possible.
Lighting and palette: deep charcoal and graphite shadows, subdued teal practical light, restrained lime highlights, neutral skin tones. Black/white/lime art direction.
Constraints: entirely original scene; do not imitate or copy an existing photograph; no logos, no watermark, no visible text or letters, no legible screen interface. No cheesy stock-photo smiles or staged pointing at camera.

assets.name: backend-api
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original editorial thumbnail for a premium Spanish digital-engineering company website backend/API service card.
Primary request: precise close editorial photograph of physical server hardware and optical connections, industrial credibility.
Scene and subject: dark server rack hardware at close range, elegant rows of metal ports, several physically credible fiber-optic patch connections, fine machined surfaces, tiny green status indicators.
Style: premium industrial editorial photography with shallow but useful depth of field and exact tactile detail, no fantastical computer hardware.
Composition: ultra-wide landscape 3:1 banner, full-bleed photograph, no border, an oblique close perspective emphasizing connections and rack geometry across a narrow horizontal crop. Output exactly 1536 by 512 pixels if possible.
Lighting and palette: deep graphite and black, emerald and subdued teal signal light, restrained lime accents, controlled highlights on brushed dark metal.
Constraints: entirely original scene; no logos, no watermark, no visible text, numbers, labels, or letters. No people, no generic floating icons.

assets.name: applied-ai
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original editorial thumbnail for a premium Spanish digital-engineering company website applied-AI service card.
Primary request: a sophisticated dark microscopic field of fine emerald and lime luminous fibers shaped by flowing data.
Scene and subject: an abstract macro landscape of countless impossibly fine translucent filaments in precise flowing wave patterns, fine points of luminous signal along the fibers, an organic yet computational field.
Style: premium scientific-art editorial abstraction with believable optical depth, controlled luminosity, quiet sophistication, detailed fine fibers rather than thick neon tubes.
Composition: ultra-wide landscape 3:1 banner, full-bleed, no border, flow and layered fibers stretching horizontally through a narrow crop. Output exactly 1536 by 512 pixels if possible.
Lighting and palette: black and graphite void, luminous emerald and occasional lime, restrained teal depth, subtle white pinpoint highlights.
Constraints: entirely original image; no robots, no brains, no faces, no circuitry symbols, no purple, no magenta, no logos, no text, no watermark.
